correctness.rationale: The exact tree incidence map B:R^V->R^E is onto (rank |V|-1=|E|); hence all weighted edge-gradient vectors g=WBf occur and the J_w quotient semigroup norm equals ||exp(tQ)||_{1->1}, Q=-W B M^{-1}B^T C W^{-1}. Each diagonal Q_ee=-c_e(1/pi_u+1/pi_v), each incident column magnitude |Q_fe|=c_e w_f/(w_e pi_shared), so its logarithmic norm column is exactly -c_e*kappa_e/w_e. Finite-dimensional matrix log norm gives the global exponential bound and first-order equality; mu<=0 iff kappa_e>=0 for all e because c_e>0, and a cut signal realizes any column at short time. For equal pi the criterion is A_line w<=2w; Perron-Frobenius yields paths or exactly K_{1,3}, with all equal claw weights. For equal w the degree formula excludes any edge from degree>=3 to a nonleaf, forcing star/path; star leaf mass alpha and center beta require beta>=(r-2)alpha. I independently checked the generator column identity in exact rational arithmetic on a branched 4-vertex example; this is a supplement to, not replacement for, the proof. Boundary: positive masses/conductances/weights, finite trees incl one edge; no cyclic graphs; short-time amplification not an all-time monotonic increase.
